# Media ownership

**Generated by an audit, not hand-written.** Regenerate with the script in the
session scratchpad, or re-run the counts below.

Every image and font in this theme is loaded from a Shopify store by absolute
URL. The theme is shared; the media is not. This file records whose store each
asset actually lives on, so the migration to per-region media has a worklist.

## The shape of it

| | |
| :--- | ---: |
| distinct assets hardcoded in shared code | 165 |
| total references to them | 214 |
| files holding them | 23 |
| **distinct Shopify stores they belong to** | **5** |

Nothing is broken today: both URL forms resolve from any origin, so UK and UAE
render these images fine. This is an ownership and dependency problem, not an
outage. If the owning store reorganises or deletes a file, every region loses
it at once.

## What each region's own store is missing

Checked by requesting each `scentspired.com/cdn/...` path from the other
storefronts. This is the subset that would have to be uploaded before a region
can serve its own copy.

| storefront | missing | of |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| scentspired.co.uk | 39 | 41 |
| scentspired.ae | 41 | 41 |

The `cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/<store-id>/` assets were not probed: those are
canonical URLs that always resolve, so they never 404 — they simply belong to
whichever store's library they name.

## Note on the two heaviest files

`sections/aroma-selector.liquid` (2,028 lines) and
`blocks/catalog--aroma-notes.liquid` (1,744 lines) hold the most assets. They
are **not** duplicates, which was the first guess and is worth recording as
checked: they render on different pages — aroma-selector on `page.scent-2`
and `page.scent-families`, catalog--aroma-notes on `page.scent-notes` — and
share only 15 distinct asset URLs. Both need migrating; neither is redundant.
